items.t: FOUND: Missing Georgia woman located safely in Gulf County
items.x: GULF COUNTY, Fla. (WMBB) - Gulf County Sheriff's Office confirmed that Tonya Thomason, who had previously been reported missing, has been found. The report came in around 8:40 p.m. on Wednesday. Thomason was located safely.
